summary: WeShop Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting the appointment of Maria Weaver as Chief Executive Officer and Class III director, effective June 15, 2026. Paul Ellerbeck steps down as CEO but remains a director. Ms. Weaver, former Managing Director at Oaklins Desilva+Phillips, receives a $500,000 base salary, 100% bonus target, a sign-on equity grant of 100,000 fully vested restricted shares (non-transferable for one year), and eligibility for up to 900,000 performance-based restricted stock units under a four-year vesting schedule. Indemnification agreement included. No other material arrangements disclosed. The appointment underscores WeShop's strategic pivot toward U.S. expansion. Watch for subsequent equity plan adoption and execution of growth milestones.
